pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and stellate dark regions. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit sharp edge gradients and jagged boundaries, while those on the lower neck/shoulder are more elongated with high-angularity vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a grid-like topology. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-directional. Pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel width across the torso, narrowing as they extend towards the hind legs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck and shoulder with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background. The fringe consists of short, dense bristles.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Presence of avian silhouettes perched on the ridge creates localized structural breaks and additions to the mane silhouette. A slight thinning of the mane is visible at the transition point between the neck and shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: Two birds are perched directly on the dorsal ridge: one on the upper neck and another further down the spine toward the shoulder.
